finalText:
Redis died and took the service with it.

At 02:14:07 `[api]` logged `redis connection lost: connect ECONNREFUSED 10.0.0.12:6379`. Cache went to direct store reads. Store overloaded, timeouts at 5000ms, queue depth climbed 52 to 568 past max 500. All 13 reconnects failed. At 02:31:44 worker-2 hit `JavaScript heap out of memory`, then `api unresponsive, killing process group — service down`.

Fix Redis at 10.0.0.12:6379 first. Everything else is downstream.
